title: Finite adjunction on strict global Hom towers
statement: Fix D,l,hl,E,X as for the global mapping comparison. Let T be a normalized DVR tower and e_n:T.M n ≅ integralDualizingFiniteTerm l E D X n identify every transition with the scalar adjunct of integralDualizingFiniteComparison, as in he of integralDualizing_mapping_limit_global. There is a natural isomorphism of strict derived R-module tower functors integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower ≅ (integralDualizingCompactSections l E D hl X).op ⋙ integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower l E. This precedes inverse limit and assumes no integral dualizing limit object M.

proof.text: Assemble the coherent component comparison supplied by the finite-level construction into a natural isomorphism with NatIso.ofComponents.

lean.statement:
theorem integralDualizing_mapping_tower_finite_comparison
    (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, T.M n ≅ integralDualizingFiniteTerm l E D X n)
    (he : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      T.tau h ≫ (normalizedDVRRes l E X h).map (e n).hom =
        (e m).hom ≫
          (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (normalizedDVRRes l E X h)).homEquiv _ _
            (integralDualizingFiniteComparison l E D X hl h))
    : Nonempty (integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower ≅
      (integralDualizingCompactSections l E D hl X).op ⋙
        integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower l E)
